title: Gateway 502 Burst
description: Nginx returns 502 for profile requests. Static assets and other APIs remain healthy.

nodes.text: Nginx returns 502 for profile requests. Static assets and other APIs remain healthy.

actions.label: Inspect gateway errors
actions.result: Nginx reports connection refused to profile-api:3000.

actions.label: Raise proxy timeout
actions.result: Requests wait longer but still end in 502; the outage duration increases.

nodes.text: The incident continues. Temporary relief did not address the underlying cause.
observations: Requests wait longer but still end in 502; the outage duration increases.
The team still needs a diagnosis.

actions.label: Inspect gateway errors
actions.result: Nginx reports connection refused to profile-api:3000.

nodes.text: The first evidence narrows the fault domain.
observations: Nginx reports connection refused to profile-api:3000.

actions.label: Check upstream reachability
actions.result: The process is healthy but listens on 127.0.0.1 rather than 0.0.0.0.

actions.label: Correct bind address without verification
actions.result: The unverified change creates risk and the incident is escalated after the recovery window expires.

nodes.text: Evidence now supports a specific root cause.
observations: The process is healthy but listens on 127.0.0.1 rather than 0.0.0.0.

actions.label: Correct bind address
actions.result: The upstream becomes reachable and 502 responses stop.

nodes.text: Service indicators remain healthy through the observation window.
observations: The upstream becomes reachable and 502 responses stop.

nodes.text: The response window closes with customer impact unresolved.
observations: The incident is handed to the next response team.

rootCause: The profile upstream bound only to localhost after a configuration change, so Nginx could not connect over the container network.

review.explanation: The profile upstream bound only to localhost after a configuration change, so Nginx could not connect over the container network.
learningNotes: Use evidence to narrow the fault domain before changing production.
Temporary symptom relief is not the same as removing a root cause.
